send.description: Send one Slack notification through curl and verify its delivery acknowledgement. Credentials come from the host environment.

message.description: Notification text, passed literally and JSON-encoded internally. Maximum 4000 Unicode characters; no JSON object is accepted.

webhookEnv.description: Name of the host environment variable holding the credential; pass the variable name, never the secret URL or token. Default: "SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL".

timeoutSeconds.description: HTTP request timeout in seconds, from 1 to 600. Notifications are sent once without automatic retries. Default: 30.

threadTs.description: Existing Slack message timestamp for a threaded reply, such as 1712345678.123456.
